# `module` (Layout)

<!-- GENERATED by `dart run tool/reference.dart`. Do not edit. -->

Embeds a module from `modules/<name>/`: its initial page, with its own state, actions and values. It inherits the theme unless it has a style/ folder. Its routes (pages, sheets, dialogs) open over the whole app, unless `contained: true`: then it gets its own navigator and they open inside its box (a phone frame), which must have a bounded size (e.g. inside `expanded`, not `scroll`).
Shorthand: `module: food` (sets `name`).

| Prop | Kind | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | module |  |
| `contained` | literal | true or false (default); `module: food` is short for `module: {name: food}` |

Kinds are explained in REFERENCE.md (Widgets). Icons, colors and text variants: style.md.
